title: 秋兴八首 三
author: 杜甫

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 秋兴八首 三 — 杜甫
千家山郭静朝晖，一日江楼坐翠微。
信宿渔人还泛泛，清秋燕子故飞飞。
匡衡抗疏功名薄，刘向传经心事违。
同学少年多不贱，五陵衣马自轻肥。
visualReview: 老人倚坐江楼望山郭与往来渔舟，晨光柔和、秋燕仍飞；画面呈静坐久望，没有将典故人物另画成拼图，下部文字区清空。
